services.name: Tampa Bay Duck Hunting
services.desc: Join us for a Tampa Bay ducking hunting adventure, using layout boats which are low profile units to help hide from our feathery friends. These little vessels which hold up to 450 lbs sit low to the water the ducks will be flying right over you and also come face to face at times giving a very adrenaline experience that provides a great hunt. Gun and shells (steel shot) are not included with pricing, if shells are needed day of trip additional costs will apply which consist of 30 dollars a box. (please notify us before trip) When bringing your own 12 gauge shotgun, make sure the plug is in to carry a maximum of three rounds. All rates are based on two people. Additional Hunters cost $75.00
